questions.question: On which date International Day of Biological Diversity is celebrated ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**22ⁿd May.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **22ⁿd May** is declared as an **international day of Biological diversity by the United Nation** to increase understanding and spread awareness related to Biodiversity issues.
 
• **20th May** is Celebrated as **Rescue Dog Day**. It is celebrated to create awareness and Prevention of Cruelty to Animals.
 
• **22ⁿd June** is celebrated as **World Rainforest Day.** It is celebrated to mark the importance of rainforests on earth and their role in our environment.
 
• **17th May** is celebrated as **World Telecommunication Day** has been celebrated annually on 17 May since 1969, marking the founding of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) and the signing of the first International Telegraph Convention in 1865.
 
• **Biodiversity- **It refers to all the variety of life that can be found on Earth as well as to the communities that they form and the habitats in which they live.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **theme** for the International **Day** for **Biodiversity 2020** was **“our solutions are in nature.”**

questions.question: Who among the following drafted Article 370 of the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Gopalaswami Ayyangar:**

 
• Gopalaswami Ayyangar was elected to the **constituent assembly** of India. Later he was also appointed as a **member of the Drafting Committee** that was responsible to formulate the constitution of India.
 
• After the **accession of Kashmir** Jawaharlal Nehru appointed **G. Ayyangar as cabinet Minister** and made him look into the matters of Kashmir Affairs. He leads the delegation representing India in the UN on the matter of the Kashmir issue. 
 
• Gopalaswami Ayyangar was the** chief Drafter of Article 370 **that granted autonomy to the state of Jammu and Kashmir. ***Hence option 3 is correct.***

**What is Article 370?**

 
• The article gives **special status to the state of Jammu and Kashmir** in terms of autonomy and liberty to formulate there own law for the permanent citizens of the state. All Indian laws do not apply to the state of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• **The Article was scrapped on 5 August 2019.**

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution deals with formation of New States?
questions.solution:

• **Article 3-** This Article empowers the Indian parliament to form a new state by separation of territory from any state, or by uniting two or more states or parts of states.
 
• **Article 5-** Citizenship by domicile. A person who was born in India or either of the person's parents was born in India or the person must have been an ordinarily resident in the territory of India for not less than five years immediately before the commencement of the constitution.
 
• **Article 4-** This Article allows for consequential changes in the 1st Schedule i.e. names of the States in the Union of India and 4th Schedule i.e. the number of seats allotted in the Rajya Sabha for each state. Constitution will not treat any such law altering existing States or creating a new State, as the amendment.

questions.question: Which of the following is the basic SI unit of thermodynamic temperature?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelvin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelvin**- 

 
 
• The** kelvin is the base unit of temperature in the International System of Units**. 
 
• It was named after engineer and physicist William Thomson, 1st Baron Kelvin. 
 
• The** SI unit symbol is K**.
 
• The temperature is usually measured with a thermometer which is marked in several temperature scales mainly Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mole-**

 
 
• The mole is the unit of measurement for the amount of substance in the International System of Units. 
 
• It is defined as exactly **6.02214076×10²³ particles**.
 
• These units can be atoms, molecules, ions, or electrons. This particular number constant of 6.02214076×10²³ is called Avagadro Number.
 
 
 
• **Metre-***** ***
 
 
• ***​***The metre is the base unit of length in the International System of Units. 
 
• The **SI unit symbol is m**.
 
 
 
• **Candela-***** ***
 
 
• ***​***The base unit of luminous intensity in the International System of Units.
 
• The **SI unit symbol is ****cd.**

questions.question: Which of the following is a group of bacteria found in human intestines, whose presence in water indicates contamination by disease-causing microorganisms ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Coliform**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coliform bacteria are commonly found in the faeces of warm-blooded animals**.

 
 
• It is a group of related bacteria whose presence in drinking water may indicate contamination by disease-causing micro-organisms.
 
• They directly don't cause illness but their presence in drinking water indicates that disease-causing bacteria can be present in the water system.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pseudomonas bacteria **are a common form of bacteria that causes infection.

 
 
• They tend to live and breed in soil, water, and damp area.
 
 
 
• **Clostridium** is rod-shaped bacteria that are generally found in soil, water, and the intestinal tracts of humans and other animals. Various form of clostridium bacterial causes different kind of diseases some of the once are-
 
 
• ​**Botulism- **Due to Clostridium botulinum
 
• **Tetanus- **Due to Clostridium Tetani.
 
 
 
• **Streptococcus** is a kind of spherical-shaped bacteria belonging to the family Streptococcaceae. *Streptococcus* contains a variety of species, some of which cause disease in humans and animals, while others are important in the manufacture of certain fermented products.
 
 
• ​**Streptococcus Lactic** and **Streptococcus ****cremoris**- Used in the production of dairy products.
 
• **Streptococcus pygenes-** Flesh-eating bacteria. etc

• **Gujarat and Kerala** were the 2ⁿd and 3rd states respectively to implement it after Tamil Nadu.
 
• On 15 Aug 1995, it was taken as a **National scheme called ****Nutrition Support to Primary Education Scheme or Mid-Day Meal program**.
 
• It was taken under by the MHRD ministry (In 2020 name was changed to Ministry of Education).
 
• According to the scheme, all the primary and upper primary students of government schools and government-aided schools like Alternative and Innovative Education (AIE) centers and Madrasas will get free lunch.
 
• According to 2020 Ministry data over 11.9 Cr students are benefited from the scheme.
